# MEGARE Copilot instructions

Before working on any request in this repository, read and follow the root
[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). It is the shared instruction entry point for GitHub
Copilot and Codex in every conversation, including engineering, documentation,
verification, and response-format rules.

Follow its relative links to the project documents relevant to the task. Maintain
shared rules in `AGENTS.md` rather than duplicating them here.
